title: Moving lines into an existing work order does not change its reps
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create a first work order for this test for that customer with two approved lines, Labor set to sales rep A and Parts set to sales rep B.
  • Create a second work order for this test for that customer with one Sales Representative, sales rep C.
  • Open the first work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Move one line of the first work order to the existing second work order.
  2. Open the second work order.
  3. Open the first work order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The line moves.

Step 2:

  • The second work order still has one Sales Representative, sales rep C.

Step 3:

  • The first work order still has Labor sales rep A and Parts sales rep B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R29: “A work order or part sale made from another one, by Split Work Order, Split Part Sale or reopening a paid work order, starts with the representatives of the one it came from: one field, or the Labor and Parts fields with the same people. It does not take the customer's.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, Phase 6 split and move: “Moving lines to an EXISTING target WO does not touch reps.”
